Original:
Ishqam Imam Hussain
Janam Imam Hussain
Translation:
My love is Imam Hussain.
My very soul is Imam Hussain.

Original:
Tere aashiq Adam, Nooh o Khatam,
Imam Hussain
Translation:
Adam, Nuh and the Seal of the Prophets are all among your lovers,
O Imam Hussain.

Original:
Tu wiqar e shah e bandagi
Tu qarar e rooh e zindagi
Tu asaae jaan e bekasi
Tere bas me sabki bebasi
Wo sada halmin hai teri
Jo pukarti hai aaj bhi
Door ghamo ko kardeta hai tera gham Imam Hussain
Translation:
You are the honour of the King of servitude.
You are the peace of every living soul.
You are the support of every lonely heart.
All helplessness lies within your care.
Your cry of 'Is there anyone to help me?' 
Still calls out today.
Your grief removes every other sorrow, O Imam Hussain.

Original:
Hai ambiya ka khayal tu
Hai Waris e bemisal tu
Balagal ulaa bikamal tu
Kashaf al duja bi jamal tu
Hasunat jami o khisaal tu
Salu alaiyi wa Aal tu
Jaan e durood e paighambar hai tera dam Imam Hussain
Translation:
You are the concern of all the Prophets.
You are the incomparable heir.
You attained the highest perfection.
You dispelled darkness through your beauty.
All noble qualities are perfected in you.
Blessings be upon him and his family.
Your very breath is the soul of blessings upon the Prophet, O Imam Hussain.

Original:
Aye wujood e shah e karbala
Aye daleel e noor e kibriya
Wo kareem tu hai bakhuda
Jo agar bujha de ik diya
Kayi soorajo ka qafila
Ye pukarta hai hum fida
Noor se tere roshan hai kul aalam Imam Hussain
Translation:
O very existence of the King of Karbala.
O proof of the Divine Light.
By God, you are so generous
That even if one lamp is extinguished,
A caravan of suns would arise.
They all proclaim, 'We are sacrificed for you.'
Your light illuminates the entire universe, O Imam Hussain.

Original:
Tujhe kiya mitaye koi shar
Tu yazeediyo ke dil me dar
Aye Imam e jin o al bashar
Tera rob rob e zul asar
Jo zabar hai abhi bhi zer par
Jo jalal e haq hai mutabar
Sher e khuda ka sher hai tera zaigham Imam Hussain
Translation:
How could any evil erase your name?
You remain the terror of the Yazidis.
O Imam of jinn and mankind.
Your awe still overpowers every tyrant.
The oppressed still triumph over the arrogant.
Yours is the majestic glory of Truth.
The Lion of God proclaims your message, O Imam Hussain.

Original:
Aye bahar e jaan e ashiqaan
Aye sukoon e qalb e meherbaan
Tu shaheed e ishq e jaawidan
Tera dard beher e bekaran
Teri ghurbato ki daasitaan
Likhe khoon rang aasmaan
Translation:
O springtime of the lovers' souls.
O comfort of every loving heart.
You are the martyr of eternal love.
Your pain is an endless ocean.
The story of your loneliness
Is written across the sky in blood.

Original:
Dil ki hai aaj aarzo
Mola hun tere roobaro
Ashko se aankhe bawazu
Karta ho qalb guftugu
Tere lahoo ka rang o buu
Phaila ho noor chaar suu
Kash ho karbobala ki galiya Or hum Imam Hussain
Translation:
Today my heart has but one desire:
My Master, that I stand before you.
My eyes are purified with tears.
My heart speaks only to you.
May the colour and fragrance of your blood
Spread light in every direction.
Would that we were walking the streets of Karbala with you, O Imam Hussain.

Original:
Aye gareeb e dasht e nainawa
Aye shaheed e arz e karbala
Tere qurb neher e alqama
Teri piyas par hai ghamzada
Tah e taig ibn e Saiyada
Tujhe roo rahi hai khud qaza
Zainab ye keh kar karti hai matam Imam Hussain
Translation:
O lonely one of the plains of Nainawa.
O martyr of the land of Karbala.
Near you flows the River Alqama.
Even it mourns your thirst.
Beneath the tyrant's sword, O son of the noble Lady,
Even death itself weeps for you.
With these words, Zainab mourns you, O Imam Hussain.
